verdict.rationale: Publishing a readable robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so the axis applies. Probes found no readable crawl policy: both ohiosos.gov and the Business Central filing portal returned HTTP 403 at robots.txt itself, and the portal also returned 404 on one same-day request. Nothing in the docs claims a published robots.txt, so this is not a dispute; an agent gets no crawl policy before fetching.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
